from collections import Counter
# Reconstruct demo input compactly from the displayed regular structure.
di=[[7]*30 for _ in range(30)]
for r in [4,7,15,21]: di[r]=[5]*30
for r,c in [(4,18),(7,7),(15,17),(21,11)]:
    di[r][c-1:c+2]=[2,2,2]
di[1][14]=3; di[27][14]=3
code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    counts=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    bg=counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    special=[(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(len(grid)) for c in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[r][c] not in (bg,5,8)]
    # Sources are the isolated cells; targets are the middle of length-three runs on full rows.
    sources=[]; targets=[]
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        if len(set(row))==1: continue
        vals=Counter(row)
        line=vals.most_common(1)[0][0]
        if vals[line]>=len(row)-5:
            runs=[c for c,x in enumerate(row) if x!=line]
            if len(runs)==3 and runs==list(range(runs[0],runs[0]+3)):
                targets.append((r,runs[1]))
    for r in range(len(grid)):
        for c in range(len(grid[0])):
            if grid[r][c] not in (bg,5,8) and all((r,c)!=(tr,tc) for tr,tc in targets) and grid[r][c] not in (2,7):
                sources.append((r,c))
    # The isolated source color is the only color occurring exactly twice.
    color=[x for x,n in counts.items() if n==2][0]
    sources=[(r,c) for r in range(len(grid)) for c in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[r][c]==color]
    points=sorted(sources+targets)
    cur=points[0]
    for p in points[1:]:
        r,c=p
        if p in targets:
            elbow=r-1
            for rr in range(min(cur[0],elbow),max(cur[0],elbow)+1): g[rr][cur[1]]=color
            for cc in range(min(cur[1],c),max(cur[1],c)+1): g[elbow][cc]=color
            g[r][c]=color; g[r+1][c]=color
        else:
            for rr in range(min(cur[0],r),max(cur[0],r)+1): g[rr][cur[1]]=color
            for cc in range(min(cur[1],c),max(cur[1],c)+1): g[r][cc]=color
        cur=p
    return g
'''
